```zig
const std = @import("std");
const builtin = @import("builtin");

pub fn matmul_avx512(a: []const f64, b: []const f64, c: []f64, m: usize, n: usize, k: usize) void {
    if (builtin.cpu.arch != .x86_64) {
        return matmul_fallback(a, b, c, m, n, k);
    }
    
    const vector_width = 8;
    var i: usize = 0;
    while (i < m) : (i += 1) {
        var j: usize = 0;
        while (j + vector_width <= n) : (j += vector_width) {
            var sum = @Vector(8, f64){0} ** 8;
            var l: usize = 0;
            while (l < k) : (l += 1) {
                const a_val = @splat(8, a[i * k + l]);
                const b_vals = @as(@Vector(8, f64), b[l * n + j..][0..8].*);
                sum += a_val * b_vals;
            }
            @as(*[8]f64, @ptrCast(&c[i * n + j])).* = sum;
        }
        while (j < n) : (j += 1) {
            var sum_scalar: f64 = 0;
            for (0..k) |l| {
                sum_scalar += a[i * k + l] * b[l * n + j];
            }
            c[i * n + j] = sum_scalar;
        }
    }
}
```

```futhark
def matmul_relu_dropout [m][n][k] (a: [m][k]f64) (b: [k][n]f64) (dropout_mask: [m][n]bool) (dropout_p: f64): [m][n]f64 =
  map (\i ->
    map (\j ->
      let sum = reduce (+) 0.0 (map2 (*) a[i] (transpose b)[j])
      let relu_val = f64.max 0.0 sum
      in if dropout_mask[i,j] then relu_val / (1.0 - dropout_p) else 0.0
    ) (iota n)
  ) (iota m)

def fused_attention [seq][head_dim] (q: [seq][head_dim]f64) (k: [seq][head_dim]f64) (v: [seq][head_dim]f64) (scale: f64): [seq][head_dim]f64 =
  let scores = map (\qi -> map (\kj -> (reduce (+) 0.0 (map2 (*) qi kj)) * scale) k) q
  let exp_scores = map (map f64.exp) scores
  let sum_exp = map (reduce (+) 0.0) exp_scores
  let attention_weights = map2 (map2 (/)) exp_scores sum_exp
  in map (\ai -> map (\vj -> reduce (+) 0.0 (map2 (*) ai vj)) (transpose v)) attention_weights
```

```zig
const TensorPool = struct {
    allocator: Allocator,
    pool: std.ArrayList([]u8),
    sizes: std.ArrayList(usize),
    free_list: std.ArrayList(usize),
    
    pub fn init(allocator: Allocator) !TensorPool {
        return TensorPool{
            .allocator = allocator,
            .pool = std.ArrayList([]u8).init(allocator),
            .sizes = std.ArrayList(usize).init(allocator),
            .free_list = std.ArrayList(usize).init(allocator),
        };
    }
    
    pub fn acquire(self: *TensorPool, size: usize) ![]u8 {
        for (self.free_list.items, 0..) |idx, i| {
            if (self.sizes.items[idx] >= size) {
                _ = self.free_list.swapRemove(i);
                return self.pool.items[idx][0..size];
            }
        }
        const new_buffer = try self.allocator.alloc(u8, size);
        try self.pool.append(new_buffer);
        try self.sizes.append(size);
        return new_buffer;
    }
    
    pub fn release(self: *TensorPool, buffer: []u8) !void {
        for (self.pool.items, 0..) |pooled, idx| {
            if (pooled.ptr == buffer.ptr) {
                try self.free_list.append(idx);
                return;
            }
        }
    }
};
```

```zig
pub fn get(self: *const Tensor, indices: []const usize) !f64 {
    if (indices.len != self.shape.len) return error.DimensionMismatch;
    var idx: usize = self.offset;
    for (indices, 0..) |i, dim| {
        if (i >= self.shape[dim]) return error.IndexOutOfBounds;
        const checked_mul = @mulWithOverflow(i, self.strides[dim]);
        if (checked_mul[1] != 0) return error.IntegerOverflow;
        const checked_add = @addWithOverflow(idx, checked_mul[0]);
        if (checked_add[1] != 0) return error.IntegerOverflow;
        idx = checked_add[0];
    }
    const byte_offset = @mulWithOverflow(idx, @sizeOf(f64));
    if (byte_offset[1] != 0 or byte_offset[0] + @sizeOf(f64) > self.data.len) 
        return error.BufferOverflow;
    return @as(*const f64, @alignCast(@ptrCast(&self.data[byte_offset[0]]))).*;
}
```

```elixir
def handle_info({:worker_ready, worker_pid}, state) do
  worker_id = Enum.find_key(state.workers, fn _id, pid -> pid == worker_pid end)
  if worker_id in state.idle_workers do
    {:noreply, state}
  else
    new_idle = [worker_id | state.idle_workers]
    new_state = %{state | idle_workers: new_idle}
    dispatch_tasks_atomic(new_state)
  end
end

defp dispatch_tasks_atomic(state) do
  case :queue.out(state.task_queue) do
    {{:value, {task, start_time}}, new_queue} ->
      case state.idle_workers do
        [worker_id | rest_idle] ->
          worker_pid = state.workers[worker_id]
          :ok = JAIDE.Worker.assign_task(worker_pid, task, start_time)
          new_state = %{state | task_queue: new_queue, idle_workers: rest_idle}
          {:noreply, new_state}
        [] ->
          {:noreply, state}
      end
    {:empty, _} ->
      {:noreply, state}
  end
end
```

```python
# src/distributed/ray_coordinator.py
import ray
from ray.util.accelerators import get_cuda_device_count
from typing import List, Any
import msgpack

@ray.remote(num_gpus=1)
class TensorWorker:
    def __init__(self, gpu_id: int):
        import cupy as cp
        self.gpu_id = gpu_id
        cp.cuda.Device(gpu_id).use()
        self.stream = cp.cuda.Stream()
        
    def matmul(self, a_bytes: bytes, b_bytes: bytes, shape_a: tuple, shape_b: tuple) -> bytes:
        import cupy as cp
        with self.stream:
            a = cp.frombuffer(a_bytes, dtype=cp.float64).reshape(shape_a)
            b = cp.frombuffer(b_bytes, dtype=cp.float64).reshape(shape_b)
            result = cp.matmul(a, b)
            return result.get().tobytes()
    
    def pipeline_forward(self, layer_weights: List[bytes], input_bytes: bytes) -> bytes:
        import cupy as cp
        with self.stream:
            x = cp.frombuffer(input_bytes, dtype=cp.float64)
            for weight_bytes in layer_weights:
                w = cp.frombuffer(weight_bytes, dtype=cp.float64)
                x = cp.maximum(cp.matmul(x, w), 0)  # ReLU
            return x.get().tobytes()

@ray.remote
class ModelParallelCoordinator:
    def __init__(self, num_gpus: int, num_layers: int):
        self.num_gpus = num_gpus
        self.num_layers = num_layers
        self.workers = [TensorWorker.remote(i % num_gpus) for i in range(num_layers)]
        self.layer_assignments = {i: i % num_gpus for i in range(num_layers)}
        
    async def forward_pass_async(self, input_data: bytes, layer_weights: List[bytes]) -> bytes:
        futures = []
        current_data = input_data
        for layer_id, weight in enumerate(layer_weights):
            worker = self.workers[layer_id]
            future = worker.pipeline_forward.remote([weight], current_data)
            futures.append(future)
            current_data = await future
        return current_data
    
    def data_parallel_forward(self, batch: List[bytes], weights: List[bytes]) -> List[bytes]:
        futures = [
            self.workers[i % self.num_gpus].pipeline_forward.remote(weights, data)
            for i, data in enumerate(batch)
        ]
        return ray.get(futures)

def init_ray_cluster(num_nodes: int = 10, num_gpus_per_node: int = 8):
    ray.init(address='auto', _redis_password='jaide_cluster_secret')
    total_gpus = num_nodes * num_gpus_per_node
    coordinator = ModelParallelCoordinator.remote(total_gpus, num_layers=768)
```

```zig
pub const NCCLComm = struct {
    comm: c.ncclComm_t,
    rank: c_int,
    world_size: c_int,
    
    pub fn init(rank: c_int, world_size: c_int) !NCCLComm {
        var comm: c.ncclComm_t = undefined;
        var unique_id: c.ncclUniqueId = undefined;
        
        if (rank == 0) {
            _ = c.ncclGetUniqueId(&unique_id);
            // Broadcast unique_id to all ranks via MPI or Redis
        }
        
        const result = c.ncclCommInitRank(&comm, world_size, unique_id, rank);
        if (result != c.ncclSuccess) return error.NCCLInitFailed;
        
        return NCCLComm{
            .comm = comm,
            .rank = rank,
            .world_size = world_size,
        };
    }
    
    pub fn allreduce(self: *NCCLComm, sendbuff: [*]f64, recvbuff: [*]f64, count: usize, stream: c.cudaStream_t) !void {
        const result = c.ncclAllReduce(
            @ptrCast(sendbuff),
            @ptrCast(recvbuff),
            count,
            c.ncclDouble,
            c.ncclSum,
            self.comm,
            stream
        );
        if (result != c.ncclSuccess) return error.AllReduceFailed;
    }
    
    pub fn broadcast(self: *NCCLComm, buff: [*]f64, count: usize, root: c_int, stream: c.cudaStream_t) !void {
        const result = c.ncclBroadcast(
            @ptrCast(buff),
            @ptrCast(buff),
            count,
            c.ncclDouble,
            root,
            self.comm,
            stream
        );
        if (result != c.ncclSuccess) return error.BroadcastFailed;
    }
    
    pub fn deinit(self: *NCCLComm) void {
        _ = c.ncclCommDestroy(self.comm);
    }
};
```

```elixir
defmodule JAIDE.DistributedTensor do
  use GenServer
  require Logger
  
  @shared_memory_path "/dev/shm/jaide_tensors"
  
  defstruct [:shm_fd, :mmap_ptr, :tensor_registry, :node_rank, :world_size]
  
  def start_link(opts) do
    GenServer.start_link(__MODULE__, opts, name: __MODULE__)
  end
  
  @impl true
  def init(opts) do
    node_rank = opts[:rank] || 0
    world_size = opts[:world_size] || 1
    
    shm_path = "#{@shared_memory_path}_#{node_rank}"
    shm_fd = :os.cmd('shm_open #{shm_path} O_CREAT|O_RDWR 0666') |> List.to_integer()
    :os.cmd('ftruncate #{shm_fd} #{100 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024}')  # 100GB shared memory
    
    {:ok, mmap_ptr} = :mmap.open(shm_fd, [:read, :write, :shared], 100 * 1024 * 1024 * 1024)
    
    state = %__MODULE__{
      shm_fd: shm_fd,
      mmap_ptr: mmap_ptr,
      tensor_registry: %{},
      node_rank: node_rank,
      world_size: world_size
    }
    
    {:ok, state}
  end
  
  def alloc_tensor(shape, dtype) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:alloc, shape, dtype})
  end
  
  def get_tensor_ptr(tensor_id) do
    GenServer.call(__MODULE__, {:get_ptr, tensor_id})
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_call({:alloc, shape, dtype}, _from, state) do
    size = Enum.reduce(shape, 1, &*/2) * dtype_size(dtype)
    tensor_id = :crypto.strong_rand_bytes(16) |> Base.encode64()
    offset = map_size(state.tensor_registry) * size
    
    tensor_meta = %{
      id: tensor_id,
      shape: shape,
      dtype: dtype,
      offset: offset,
      size: size,
      node: state.node_rank
    }
    
    new_registry = Map.put(state.tensor_registry, tensor_id, tensor_meta)
    
    broadcast_tensor_alloc(tensor_meta, state.world_size)
    
    {:reply, {:ok, tensor_id}, %{state | tensor_registry: new_registry}}
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_call({:get_ptr, tensor_id}, _from, state) do
    case Map.get(state.tensor_registry, tensor_id) do
      nil -> {:reply, {:error, :not_found}, state}
      meta -> {:reply, {:ok, state.mmap_ptr + meta.offset}, state}
    end
  end
  
  defp dtype_size(:f64), do: 8
  defp dtype_size(:f32), do: 4
  defp dtype_size(:i32), do: 4
  
  defp broadcast_tensor_alloc(meta, world_size) do
    for rank <- 0..(world_size - 1) do
      node = :"jaide_node_#{rank}@jaide-gpu-workers-#{rank}.jaide-gpu-headless"
      GenServer.cast({__MODULE__, node}, {:register_tensor, meta})
    end
  end
  
  @impl true
  def handle_cast({:register_tensor, meta}, state) do
    new_registry = Map.put(state.tensor_registry, meta.id, meta)
    {:noreply, %{state | tensor_registry: new_registry}}
  end
end
```

```bash
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail

export JAIDE_VERSION=v35
export CLUSTER_SIZE=10000
export GPU_PER_NODE=8
export TOTAL_GPUS=$((CLUSTER_SIZE * GPU_PER_NODE))

helm install jaide-cluster ./charts/jaide \
  --namespace jaide-production \
  --create-namespace \
  --set global.image.tag=${JAIDE_VERSION} \
  --set gpu.workers.replicas=${CLUSTER_SIZE} \
  --set gpu.workers.gpusPerNode=${GPU_PER_NODE} \
  --set nccl.enabled=true \
  --set nccl.backend=infiniband \
  --set monitoring.prometheus.enabled=true \
  --set monitoring.grafana.enabled=true \
  --set autoscaling.enabled=true \
  --set autoscaling.minReplicas=5000 \
  --set autoscaling.maxReplicas=20000 \
  --set autoscaling.targetGPUUtilization=85 \
  --set security.mTLS.enabled=true \
  --set security.networkPolicies.enabled=true \
  --values production-secrets.yaml \
  --timeout 30m \
  --wait

kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: jaide.ai/v1
kind: DistributedTraining
metadata:
  name: jaide-v35-training
  namespace: jaide-production
spec:
  model:
    architecture: FMRN
    parameters: 18.432T
    layers: 768
    hiddenSize: 18432
    attentionHeads: 144
    sequenceLength: 128000
  training:
    strategy: ZeRO-3
    mixedPrecision: bf16
    gradientCheckpointing: true
    optimizer:
      type: CelestialZO
      lr: 0.0001
      betas: [0.9, 0.999]
      eps: 1e-8
    dataParallel:
      worldSize: ${TOTAL_GPUS}
      gradientAccumulationSteps: 32
    modelParallel:
      tensorParallelSize: 8
      pipelineParallelSize: 96
  resources:
    gpusPerWorker: ${GPU_PER_NODE}
    memoryPerGPU: 80Gi
    interconnect: infiniband
  checkpointing:
    enabled: true
    interval: 1000
    backend: minio
    path: s3://jaide-checkpoints/v35
EOF

echo "JAIDE V35 Production Cluster Deployed: ${TOTAL_GPUS} GPUs"
kubectl get pods -n jaide-production -l app=jaide-gpu-worker -o wide
```
